title: Francis Coralie Mullin v. Administrator, Union Territory of Delhi

content.caseIdentity: Francis Coralie Mullin v. Administrator, Union Territory of Delhi, (1981) 1 SCC 608
content.holding: Right to life includes the right to live with human dignity and the bare necessities of life; it is not confined to animal existence.
content.relevance: Foundational citation when expanding Article 21 beyond physical restraint—prison conditions, dignity, and socio-economic facets.
